[[File:Holocron_repository.jpg|thumb|200px|The Holocron repository located in the secretive part of the Surgical Center.]]
This '''Sith Holocron repository''' was a structure used to store [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocrons]].

==History==
[[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] placed the repository inside the [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center|EmPal SuRecon Center]] and used it as part of his Dark Force reservoir. It contained many Holocrons which he had either found or forcibly taken from its guardians.
